headline: OceanPact Sells Two Vessels for $86 Million to Boost Liquidity
summary: OceanPact announced that its Norwegian subsidiaries signed memoranda of understanding to sell the CBO Energy and CBO Wiser vessels to an international offshore maritime support group for $43 million each, totaling $86 million.
why: OceanPact provides marine environmental and subsea services in Latin America, and asset sales can materially impact corporate liquidity and prospective shareholder dividends.

impacts.name: OceanPact Servicos Maritimos SA
impacts.why: A major asset sale generating $86 million improves cash flow and reinforces the potential for future dividend distributions.
